explain.say: Look at the ball and the arrow. Your kick is a push. It makes the ball roll away. A gentle kick makes the ball roll slowly. A hard kick makes it roll fast.
Now look at a tug of war. Both teams pull with the same strength. The arrows are the same size. So the rope stays still. Tomorrow, count the pushes and pulls you do before breakfast.

forces.label: Team B pulls
forces.ask: Why does nobody move in tug of war?

faq.a: A force is a push or a pull. Forces can make things start moving, stop, speed up, slow down, change direction or change shape.

faq.q: Is opening a door a push or a pull?
faq.a: It can be either! If the door opens away from you, you push it. If it opens towards you, you pull it. Many doors have a sign saying which.
asks: Is opening a drawer a pull?

faq.q: Why does nobody move in tug of war?
faq.a: When both teams pull equally hard in opposite directions, the forces balance, so the rope stays still. The stronger team makes it move their way.

faq.q: What happens if you push harder?
faq.a: A bigger push makes things speed up more. A gentle kick rolls a ball slowly. A hard kick makes it go fast and far.
asks: Does a bigger force make things go faster?

faq.q: Can a force change the shape of something?
faq.a: Yes. Squeezing play dough, stretching a rubber band or squashing a sponge are forces changing an object's shape.

facts: A force is a push or a pull, measured in newtons.
When forces on an object are balanced, its motion does not change.

quiz.say: You open a drawer. It moves towards you. Which force is that?
quiz.show: The drawer moves towards you. Which force?
quiz.why: The drawer moves towards you. A force that moves something towards you is a pull.

wrong.0: A push moves things away from you. The drawer moves towards you.
wrong.2: You twist a jar lid. A drawer slides straight towards you.

quiz.say: In tug of war, both teams pull equally hard. What happens?
quiz.show: Equal pulls in tug of war. What happens?
quiz.why: The 2 pulls are the same size and go opposite ways. They balance, so the rope stays still.

wrong.1: A strong rope holds. The 2 pulls balance each other.
wrong.2: The pulls balance, so everyone stays in place.
